Zaylist Foundation
Release: zaylist-foundation-2026-08-06.2
Authority: Tucker decisions > canonical standards and accepted records > verified production implementation > Foundation recommendations > research, prototypes, exports, migrations, and open questions.
Decision records: foundation/decisions/ (YAML, one record per file)
Chapters: foundation/chapters/
Agent continuity and handoff: foundation/agent-continuity/manifest.json
Domain guides: foundation/tech-stack/llms.txt, foundation/trust-safety/llms.txt
Explorations: foundation/explorations/ - raw session thinking, append-only, condensation prohibited. NO AUTHORITY. Sits at the bottom of the authority order with research and open questions. Never cite an exploration as a rule, standard, decision, or plan of record. An enthusiastic idea recorded there is still not founder direction. When only an exploration covers a topic, the correct answer is that no decision exists yet. Ideas leave that folder only by being promoted into a decision record, which is an explicit act.
Reading a decision: check status before applying it. Accepted and current are authoritative. Recommendation, draft, queued, and deferred are not. Superseded records remain for history and must not be applied.
Never treat implementation_state: not-implemented as shipped, deployed, or live. Never call a local edit, prototype, export, or recommendation implemented. Preserve unknown as unknown.
Release discipline: every governed area carries a Release id in its llms.txt. Changing content in an area without moving that id is a build failure, enforced by scripts/check-foundation-release.mjs and .github/workflows/foundation-release.yml. Format: zaylist-<area>-YYYY-MM-DD.N. Bump the trailing number, or roll the date and reset to .1. foundation/agent-continuity/ is exempt: it is operational handoff state with its own schema and freshness fields, not a published guide. Treat a release id you have seen before as a guarantee that nothing in that area moved.
Live tunnels: foundation/agent-continuity/tunnels/ - temporary topic-scoped agent chat rooms. Nine digit codes, first three digits are the topic. Transcripts carry NO AUTHORITY; authority attaches only to what a closing agent writes into the library. Closing requires an outcome and the paths updated. Archived at tunnels/archive/YYYY-MM/. Contract: foundation/agent-continuity/tunnels/README.md
